_comment: EXP-1057: THE mini-graph look, identical x4 (web lib/issue-graph.ts, desktop domain::issue_graph, iOS ExpCore IssueGraph.Geometry, Android domain/IssueGraph.Geometry). Points (web px = desktop px = iOS pt = Android dp). A node box sits at x = inset + wave * (nodeWidth + waveGap), y = inset + lane * (nodeHeight + laneGap); the grid is the boxes plus `inset` on every side (room for the rings, never clipped). The viewport is min(grid, maxView*) and scrolls past it. An edge leaves its blocker's right-middle and enters the blocked box's left-middle; forward it curves inside the gap, both control points on the gap's middle; a backward (cycle) edge bows by max(waveGap / 2, |dx| / 2). The rail (web + desktop lists) draws DOTS only: `railGutter` + `railNodeWidth` wide, a `railDot` dot with a `railDotRing` ring; hovering a dot opens the mini-graph.

edges.name: a forward edge bends on the gap's middle
a backward cycle edge bows by half its run
